description: Index the codebase for fast lookup. Five tools that read/write a persistent code index at data/db/index.db — find symbols, API routes, UI components, feature tags, and opportunities across the repo without reading every file.
skill_summary: How to index a codebase and keep the index alive: discover unindexed files, spawn parallel indexer helpers, tag features, log opportunities, query the index, and — most importantly — update the index every time you read or edit a file so it stays accurate through normal work. Load before any indexing, searching, code editing, or opportunity-review task.
